editorial.name: southleft/figma-console-mcp
editorial.descriptionZh: 一个 MCP server，把 Figma 设计系统当成 API 暴露给 AI 客户端，用来做变量与组件的提取、创建和调试。
editorial.takeawayZh: 接上这个 MCP，让 AI 直接读写 Figma 设计系统
editorial.noteZh: 仓库 About 栏写着 Your design system as an API. Connect AI to Figma for extraction, creation, and debugging.，标着 MIT license、2.3k stars、245 forks，话题标签是 ai、design-systems、figma、figma-plugins、mcp。README 目录从 What is this?、Quick Start、Installation Method Comparison、Test Your Connection、Authentication 排到 Available Tools、Example Prompts、Desktop Bridge Plugin、Multi-Instance Support、MCP Apps、vs. Figma Official MCP、Roadmap；最新提交是 Release v1.40.0 — Design System Extraction，文件树里有 figma-desktop-bridge、src、tests 和一份 CLAUDE.md。

reasons.statement: 仓库自述 Your design system as an API. Connect AI to Figma for extraction, creation, and debugging，把设计源文件里的变量与组件抽出来交给下游，属于设计到交付这一环而不是界面组件本身。
README 有 Desktop Bridge Plugin、Authentication、Installation Method Comparison 等节，安装与连接才是使用它的第一步，符合交付与开发协作工具。
